description_en: Invokes this operation to configure project cooperation settings so that an Alibaba Cloud account can grant authorization on different projects to different Resource Access Management (RAM) users
description_zh: 调用该接口设置项目协作，即阿里云账号可以给不同的RAM用户授权不同的项目
name: SetStudioProjectCooperation

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
If no ID value is displayed for a public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The project cooperation status. Valid values:
0 (default): disabled.
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
设置项目协作状态。
0（默认）： 关闭。
1： 开通
parameters.name: status

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202245.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202245.html）

Data.description_en: The result returned if the call is successful. The value is true
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回该参数，值为true

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
